CheckBoxPreference.app:title: Maximize Sensor Area
CheckBoxPreference.app:summary: Only show resolutions that use full sensor array area.

se.lth.math.videoimucapture.FloatSeekBar.app:title: Zoom ratio
se.lth.math.videoimucapture.FloatSeekBar.app:summary: Set to less than 1 to use wide lens.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Enable Distortion Correction
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Lets the HAL un-warp the frames before you get them. Leave OFF. The distortion_params (k1..k5) recorded in every session describe the RAW sensor, so a solve that trusts them on corrected frames corrects twice — and a HAL correction is a warp with no published functional form, which no PINHOLE or OPENCV camera in COLMAP can express. Both failure modes look like a slightly-worse-than-expected reprojection error, which is the signature this project has learned not to trust. The mode that actually ran is recorded per frame.

ListPreference.app:title: Lenses in the session
ListPreference.app:summary: Which physical rear cameras get a stream. "Metric pair" is main + ultrawide, the two with a published 18.02 mm baseline, and is how every clip in the archive was shot. "All lenses" adds the 3x and 5x telephotos, so one press captures the same instant from every rear camera — this device configures preview + JPEG + RAW + four physical streams at 1920x1080, seven streams in one session. The telephotos publish no pose translation, so the extra views carry no scale of their own. Takes effect when the camera is next opened.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Focus at hyperfocal (manual focus only)
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: With focus mode MANUAL, park the lens at the hyperfocal distance instead of the distance slider — everything from about half of it to infinity is acceptably sharp, and the voice coil never moves again. Continuous AF hunts, and a lens that moves between frames breathes the focal length by a few percent across a session, which is the constant freeze_intrinsics asserts downstream. Computed from this lens: H = f²/(N·c) + f, circle of confusion = sensor diagonal / 1500. Unverified: nobody has yet plotted how much the focal actually moves on an AF-on walk, and if it turns out flat this is not needed.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Raw pixels for the matcher
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Turns the HAL's edge enhancement and noise reduction OFF. Neither key has ever been set in this fork, so every frame in the archive was sharpened and denoised to human taste. Sharpening manufactures gradients — a halo sits at a fixed offset from an edge in image space, so the same physical edge looks different from two distances and the detector locks onto the halo. Denoise erases exactly the low-contrast texture a matcher needs. OFF here leaves the keys untouched rather than setting FAST, so the archive stays comparable; the mode that ran is now recorded per frame either way. Unmeasured — shoot N1/N2.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Record IMU
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Gyroscope, accelerometer and magnetometer, hardware-timestamped on the same clock as the frames. This is what makes a clip a measurement rather than a video, so it is ON for every clip in the archive; turn it off only for a deliberately camera-only take. While recording, the readout shows the delivered rate (IMU: 416Hz) or IMU: OFF, and the warning light comes on whenever the stream is not running.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Record GNSS
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Position fixes, per-satellite raw measurements and broadcast ephemeris, from the GPS provider directly. Needs the location permission and the device location switch; the status line below says which of those is missing. While recording, the readout shows the live fix (GNSS: FIX 9/21sv +-4m), GNSS: NOFIX while searching, or the reason it is not running.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Freeze exposure while recording
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Lock AE and AWB at the first frame so the clip has one radiometry. Off (with Continuous mode): auto exposure keeps running through the whole session and every frame records its own exposure and ISO.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Blur budget (experimental)
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Cap exposure from the gyro so motion blur stays under the budget below, letting ISO rise instead. Needs Freeze exposure OFF. UNTESTED — verify on your device. Shows HOLD STILL when you are moving too fast for a sharp frame.

SeekBarPreference.app:title: Blur budget (pixels)
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: Target maximum motion smear per frame, pixels. The AE cap aims at this.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Manual shutter for the budget (experimental)
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: When the budget needs a shutter shorter than 1/30 s — which is anything above a slow walk — take auto exposure off and set the shutter directly, raising ISO to match. This is the only setting on this phone that can actually meet the budget while walking; the AE cap alone stops at 1/30 s. It hands exposure back the moment you slow down. Costs noise, which the per-frame noise profile can model; blur cannot be modelled away.

SeekBarPreference.app:title: Hold-still alarm (pixels)
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: Show HOLD STILL when predicted smear passes this. Separate from the budget above, because at 30 fps the budget is not reachable while walking and an alarm tied to it never goes off. The live SMEAR readout tells you where to set this: a measured S24U walk ran 24 px typical, 63 px at its worst.

SeekBarPreference.app:title: Video bitrate
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: Mbit/s. 0 = automatic (about 94 for the full sensor at 30 fps).

SeekBarPreference.app:title: Stereo pair every (seconds)
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: While recording, keep a simultaneous ultrawide + main frame pair at this interval — a known 18 mm baseline every metre of walk, for scale. 0 = off. Runs the second sensor for the whole clip. Measured 2026-09-10 in a dark room: pairs land and are the same frame on both lenses; the video kept its frame count but its cadence roughened (the sensor held 30 fps and every other frame was encoded). Daylight unmeasured — shoot S1 and S2 there before a real walk.

SeekBarPreference.app:title: IMU batching
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: Milliseconds the gyro, accelerometer and magnetometer may buffer in their own FIFO before waking the CPU. 0 = off, which is how every clip in the archive was shot. Samples are hardware-timestamped, so batching delays delivery without moving a sample in time — for pure recording it costs nothing and saves ~470 wakeups a second per sensor while the GPU encodes. It is NOT free for the stillness shutter or the blur budget, which read the stream live: a quiet moment detected 100 ms late is a still fired 14 cm further down the walk. Leave at 0 for stills runs. Unmeasured on this device.

SeekBarPreference.app:title: Camera sleep after
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: Seconds idle before the preview stops and the sensor goes quiet. 0 = never. Tap to wake.
